Document changes through document control systems, Process Alerts, One Point Lessons and standardized work instructions
Target key KPIs, such as quality, safety, rate and downtime; set targets, analyze data and monitor trends, and drive projects to meet those targets

Utilize lean manufacturing tools and concepts such as value stream mapping, line balancing, and 5S for continuous improvement

Monitor project schedules, timelines and deliverables using standard project management tools and engineering systems

Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent, required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record in manufacturing or vehicle assembly environments.
Demonstrated expertise with hardware, tools, instruments, general electromechanical systems, and measurement techniques.
Substantial experience in data collection and analysis.
Exceptional communication skills: written, verbal, and email, with a strong ability to work effectively across vehicle assembly and engineering teams.
Preferred Requirements
Deep knowledge of ergonomic process design, part variation control, and human factors effects on product.
Advanced knowledge of statistical tools including SPC to characterize and optimize process performance.
Strong problem-solving abilities and a proven capacity to learn complex systems quickly.

Work alongside firmware, quality, safety, and production teams to improve, change, or implement processes; identify areas of improvement with existing processes and manufacturing line areas to help optimize factory processes
Coordinate document changes through document control systems, Process Alerts, One Point Lessons, and standardized work instructions
Support key KPIs such as quality, safety, rate, and downtime; help set targets, analyze data, monitor trends, and work with the team on projects to meet those targets
Coordinate with Manufacturing, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Product Introduction, and other teams to define, qualify, and track new processes and all associated work instructions, equipment, tools, materials, and training
Contribute to supporting activities for Engineering and Manufacturing including 5S and Lean manufacturing activities, material handling improvements, production line configuration, and safety procedures
Apply lean manufacturing tools and concepts such as value stream mapping, line balancing, and 5S in collaboration with the team for continuous improvement
Work with the team to define and carry out process improvement studies to create, characterize, and optimize vehicle assembly processes
Use SPC data and other statistical tools alongside colleagues to characterize processes for operating performance
Share responsibility with cross-functional partners for driving process improvements throughout vehicle assembly, drawing on technical and business system skills
Help track project schedules, timelines, and deliverables using standard project management tools and engineering systems
cond_0405.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, equivalent experience, or related field
Previous manufacturing or vehicle assembly experience
Hands-on skills with hardware, tools, instruments, general electromechanical systems, and measurement techniques
Strong ability to work and communicate effectively with team and peers within a vehicle assembly and engineering organization, including written, verbal, and email communication
Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to learn systems quickly
Preferred Requirements
Experience with ergonomic process design, part variation control, and human factors effects on product
Data collection and analysis experience
Creative capacity for developing new ways to do things better, cheaper, and faster in alignment with a revolutionary product development approach
cond_0405.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0405.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

Own cross-functional work with firmware, quality, safety and production to improve, change or implement processes; identify areas of improvement with existing processes and areas of the manufacturing line to optimize factory processes
Direct changes through document control systems, Process Alerts, One Point Lessons and standardized work instructions
Target key KPIs, such as quality, safety, rate and downtime; set targets, analyze data and monitor trends, and drive projects to meet those targets
Lead cross-functional work with Manufacturing, Design Engineering, Manufacturing Product Introduction and other teams to define, qualify, and track new processes and all associated work instructions, equipment, tools, materials, and training
Execute supporting activities for Engineering and Manufacturing including 5S and Lean manufacturing activities, material handling improvements, production line configuration, and safety procedures
Apply lean manufacturing tools and concepts such as value stream mapping, line balancing, and 5S for continuous improvement
Define and execute process improvement studies to create, characterize, and optimize vehicle assembly processes
Utilize SPC data and other statistical tools to characterize processes for operating performance
Drive process improvements throughout all vehicle assembly using leadership, technical, and business system skills
Manage project schedules, timelines and deliverables using standard project management tools and engineering systems
cond_0521.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, experience, or equivalent
Previous manufacturing or vehicle assembly experience
Hands-on skills with hardware, tools, instruments, general electromechanical systems, measurement techniques
Experience with ergonomic process design, part variation control, and human factors effects on product
Data collection and analysis experience
Strong ability to work and communicate effectively with team and peers within a vehicle assembly and engineering organization. This includes excellent communication skills: written, verbal, and email
Strong problem-solving skills and an aptitude for learning systems quickly
Creative capacity for developing new ways to do things better, cheaper, faster in alignment with the aggressive [Company name masked] approach to revolutionary product development
